title: Eric Hecker's childhood involvement with the Stargate program

tellings.quote: >> I grew up on Long Island. Um I had a very peculiar history uh of nefarious activity with uh the Stargate program.

plain: Eric Hecker says that as a child growing up on Long Island, New York, he had a "very peculiar history" of "nefarious activity" with the Stargate program, the US government's secret effort to use psychics for spying. He says this on the show as his own experience, in an episode with Jay Anderson and Kurt Metzger. If true, it would mean the programme involved children.
